name: clay
description: Clay enrichment and custom functions — official MCP server plus Public API routines

requirements: OAuth client registered via dynamic client registration (PKCE mandatory) or a public API key
notes: Public API alternative: POST https://api.clay.com/public/v0/routines/{routine_id}/run with header clay-api-key, then GET .../routines/run/{routine_run_id}/results (202 while processing, 200 complete).
Running a function needs MCP access enabled on that function; API access alone is not enough. Use list_subroutines to find callable functions.
Admins control which clients are allowed and set per-user/role credit budgets. Tools consume workspace credits at the in-app rate.
